tasks.detail: Starts the dev server from the workspace root using the local venv.

tasks.label: Flask: run app (project folder)
tasks.detail: Starts the dev server from the event-management-website folder.

tasks.label: Flask: install requirements
tasks.detail: Installs the pinned requirements into the local venv.

tasks.label: Flask: stop servers on port 5000
tasks.detail: Frees port 5000 when an old server is still running (Address already in use).
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Port 5000 is now free.'
